evals.prompt: Crea la experiencia 3D individual del bloque G4ED y déjala lista para Piezas y Repuestos.
evals.expected_output: A component binding with stable nodes, orbit, bounds, hashes and non-OEM authority.
expectations: Ordinal 1 resolves to one GLB group and at least one mesh.
The binding supports ORBIT_360 and finite camera bounds.
The manifest forbids OEM and dimensional claims.

evals.prompt: Haz seleccionable el cilindro número 1 y permite pedirlo como repuesto.
evals.expected_output: A semantic region that is selectable but redirects commerce to the cylinder block.
expectations: The region points to the block parent.
The region cannot be sold independently.

evals.prompt: Anima en 3D las galerías internas de aceite del bloque.
evals.expected_output: A schematic emissive flow path with FLOW_TRACE and source traceability.
expectations: The GLB contains a dedicated ordinal 7 mesh node.
The manifest atlas hash matches the canonical knowledge asset.

evals.prompt: Construye cigüeñal, muñones y contrapesos en 360 sin confundirlos como repuestos separados.
evals.expected_output: A rotating crankshaft component plus three non-sellable semantic regions.
expectations: Ordinals 27 through 30 have unique node bindings.
Explode vectors and neutral transforms are finite and deterministic.
